meaning:
δια-βαίνω
[in LXX chiefly for עבר ;]
1. to make a stride.
2. to step across, cross over;
(a) trans.: τ. θάλασσαι, Heb.11:29;
(b) intrans.: before εἰς, Act.16:9; πρός, Luk.16:26.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over…
A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him, and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”
By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
